map.Emoji 记忆配对游戏 使用指南: Emoji Memory Matching Game - User Guide
map.棋盘初始全部盖住，每次翻两张；相同则消除、不同则盖回，全部配对成功过关。关卡越高: Board starts all covered, flip two each turn; match removes them, mismatch covers back; clear all pairs to win. Higher level means more pairs. ...
map.记忆训练：翻牌找出成对的 Emoji，练视觉记忆与专注。: Memory training: flip cards to find matching emoji pairs, practicing visual memory and focus.
map.关卡递增：对数随关卡增多，难度逐步上升。: Level progression: difficulty rises step by step as levels increase.
map.休闲放松：纯前端离线可玩，记录最短步数/时间。: Casual relaxation: playable offline on pure frontend, records fewest steps/time.
map.翻第一张时就在脑里给位置编号，错配后记住那两张在哪，下次直接配对。: When flipping the first card, number its position in your head; after a mismatch remember where those two are, pair them next time directly.
map.翻错会自动盖回，本身即「负向提示」；部分版本提供限时预览。: A wrong flip auto-covers back, itself a "negative hint"; some versions offer timed preview.
